title: HVAC Filter Runtime Threshold
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecobee:thermostat runtime_minutes=*
| stats sum(runtime_minutes) as total_runtime_minutes by filter_name
| eval runtime_hours=round(total_runtime_minutes/60,1)
| where runtime_hours>300
| sort - runtime_hours
description: Uses accumulated HVAC runtime to trigger filter changes on actual use instead of vague calendar memory.
value: Runtime-based maintenance is more honest than date-based maintenance because a mild month is not the same as a brutal one.
implementation: Roll up ecobee runtime by active filter period and alert when the chosen runtime threshold is passed.
visualization: Gauge or table of filter runtime hours against replacement threshold.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when the air filter has worked long enough that it should probably be changed.
